summary: The proposed patch introduces a call to `response.raise_for_status()` which could potentially raise an exception and disrupt the flow of the linkcheck process.

issues.description: The patch introduces a call to `response.raise_for_status()`, which will raise an exception if the HTTP response status code indicates an error (e.g., 404, 500). This could disrupt the linkcheck process and prevent it from continuing to check other links.
